info.title: OSCAR Next API
info.description: Local-first REST API for OSCAR Next CPAP data. OSCAR Next 2.2 adds a headless browser deployment for Raspberry Pi/Linux. Non-loopback binding requires a bearer token. File-system imports and removable-media watching are opt-in.

put.summary: Set or clear a machine timezone override

timeZone.description: IANA timezone. Null/empty resets to the profile timezone.

get.summary: Get chart series for a therapy day
get.description: Waveforms may be decimated to maxPointsPerSeries; event series are returned exactly. Typed arrays are serialized as JSON arrays.

post.description: Requires the API server to be started with --allow-imports. sourcePath is a path on the API host.

post.summary: Import CPAP media into the configured database
post.description: Requires --allow-imports. The sourcePath refers to the API host filesystem.

post.summary: Create and import synthetic demo data
post.description: Requires --allow-imports. Intended for acceptance testing and first-run demonstration.

200.description: ZIP containing diagnostics and redacted logs; therapy data/database not included

get.description: Contiguous therapy dates with included-session counts and mask-on usage hours. Includes summary-only sessions and zero-use days; excludes disabled sessions. Reads session metadata and slices without waveform, event or settings payloads.

get.summary: Raw-sample nightly channel statistics and leak duration
get.description: Enabled sessions only, clipped to therapy-day bounds and mask-on intervals. Duration-weighted nearest-rank percentiles; missing samples are excluded. Independent of chart visibility/decimation. Flow and uninterpreted respiratory event signals are excluded.

put.summary: Save per-machine leak threshold and graph reference line preference
Atomically update selected graph visibility without changing order, height or pin state

visible.description: Optional explicit visibility. When absent, use the graph default.

secondsAboveThreshold.description: Merged recorded elapsed time strictly above threshold

percentTherapyTimeAboveThreshold.description: 100 * secondsAboveThreshold / included mask-on therapy seconds; missing readings remain unknown

therapySeconds.description: Merged enabled mask-on elapsed time, including summary-only therapy

leak.description: Absent if no valid leak samples; never synthesize zero for missing recordings.
